description:
OBJECTIVE
Drive Lotte Cinema’s overall advertising revenue by expanding the client base, managing campaigns, and leading the sales team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* Acquire new clients/agencies and maintain key accounts. Consult clients on cinema advertising solutions (screens, LED displays, booths, activations, etc.). Negotiate and close contracts.
* Oversee campaign execution to ensure contractual commitments are met. Coordinate with Finance to ensure timely payment collection.
* Lead, train, and assign KPIs to the sales team. Coordinate smoothly with other teams.
* Develop monthly/annual sales plans, monitor business performance, and report directly to the Board of Directors.
requirements_text:
* Minimum 3 years in Advertising Sales, Media Sales, or Business Development (team management experience is preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Marketing, Communications, or related fields.
* Excellent negotiation, strong commercial mindset, business planning, and team management capabilities.
* Good communication in English
